Resolves #20067

Replaces fixed `grid.timeout(50)` sleeps in `test/playwright/unit/grid/StoreInteractions.spec.mjs` (`Grid & Store Interactions`) and `test/playwright/unit/grid/PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` (`Grid hidden row premeasurement`) with `promiseUpdate()` drain loops (`do { ... } while (isVdomUpdating || needsVdomUpdate)`) and awaits initial store construction (`await store.ready()`) before mounting.

Change class: `zero-delta` (`test`); `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit tests ran`.

Evidence: L1 (unit test execution under 9-worker and 16-worker parallel load and 1-worker sequential mode) → L1 required (AC-1–AC-3).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/StoreInteractions.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` (red on `dev` under 16-worker load: 4 failed / 188 passed; green at head across 3 consecutive `--repeat-each=4` runs: 96/96 passed each) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/StoreInteractions.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` (`--workers=1 --repeat-each=2`: 48/48 passed in 6.0s) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/StoreInteractions.spec.mjs:142-244`, `test/playwright/unit/grid/PremeasureRows.spec.mjs:22-59` (no fixed `timeout(...)` remains in setup or `captureDeltas`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Because `grid.mounted = true` synchronously triggers `headerToolbar#afterSetMounted` → `passSizeToBody()` → `body.update()` (Flight 1) before `body.set({availableHeight, containerWidth})` defers `createViewData()` into `VDomUpdate.registerPreUpdate`, and `VdomLifecycle#resolveVdomUpdate` executes promise callbacks (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1107`) before `executePreUpdates` (`:1122`), a single `await grid.body.promiseUpdate()` resolves on Flight 1 while Flight 2 is still in flight (`#issuecomment-6400196410`). Both specs now loop `promiseUpdate()` while `isVdomUpdating || needsVdomUpdate` is true.
- Added `await store.ready()` after `store = Neo.create(Store, ...)` in `StoreInteractions.spec.mjs` `beforeEach` (`Grid & Store Interactions`) so `Store#onConstructed`'s 2-microtask initial `load` resolves before `grid.mounted = true` rather than arming `GridBody#onStoreLoad`'s 50ms `DomAccess.scrollTo` timer during setup.
- Folded the identical setup and post-`repaintCells()` / post-`release()` settle race in `test/playwright/unit/grid/PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` per `#issuecomment-6367939011` and `#issuecomment-6398736425`.

## Reviews

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-10-25T16:46:29Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — test-only. The fixed 50 ms clocks become update-flight drains in two grid specs; there is no production change.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that both specs settled on a clock, while their setup can run two update flights. Verified at `8589f5ec13`. Both `settle` loops drain `promiseUpdate()` while any participant `isVdomUpdating || needsVdomUpdate`. In PremeasureRows, the per-arm settle moves into `beforeEach`, and the store-replacement arm now waits for the view as well as the bodies before measuring; that was the gap I named on #20067 (6367939011). StoreInteractions awaits `store.ready()` and asserts the 14-row pool before any arm runs, and `captureDeltas` drains instead of sleeping, which meets AC-3. My falsifier at this head, `--repeat-each=8 --workers=16` over both files, gave 192/192 twice. Dev was 4/96 red under that load (6398736425). I looked for a drain that could hide a real settle failure: none does, because a perpetual flight would time out the test instead of passing it. CI is green. No other site changed.

**Findings:** None. No required actions — eligible for human merge.
